content_units: March 11 Workday Snapshot
Focused plan for   Wednesday, 2026-03-11   in   America/New York  , built around your fixed meetings and a   hard stop at 17:30  .
Priority was given to minimizing context switching and keeping deep work in blocks of   60+ minutes  .
Optimized Schedule
Time   Block   Type   Notes
09:00-09:30   Team stand-up   Meeting   Fixed
09:30-10:45   Draft proposal outline   Deep work   75 min first block
10:45-11:00   Prepare slides for client review   Prep   15 min final polish before meeting
11:00-12:00   Client review   Meeting   Fixed
12:00-12:45   Lunch   Break   45 min
12:45-13:45   Deep research for new market   Deep work   60 min focused block
13:45-14:45   Quarterly budget review   Focus work   60 min complete block
14:45-15:15   Answer vendor emails   Admin   30 min complete block
15:15-15:30   Prepare slides for client review   Prep   15 min carryover / post-review updates
15:30-16:00   Manager check-in   Meeting   Fixed
16:00-17:00   Deep research for new market   Deep work   60 min second focused block
17:00-17:15   Draft proposal outline   Deep work   15 min carryover
17:15-17:30   Buffer / notes / next steps   Wrap-up   Protects schedule from overruns
What Fits vs What Moves
Scheduled in full:
-   Deep research for new market — 120 min
-   Quarterly budget review — 60 min
-   Answer vendor emails — 30 min
-   Lunch — 45 min
Partially scheduled:
-   Draft proposal outline — 90 min needed, 90 min scheduled total
-   Prepare slides for client review — 45 min needed, 30 min scheduled total
Deferred:
-   15 minutes of slide preparation
Best moved to   the prior day   or handled as a lighter follow-up after the client review if the intent was not pre-meeting prep only.
Why This Plan Works
- Deep work is preserved in   60-minute minimum blocks   for research.
- Proposal drafting is kept mostly contiguous early in the day when focus is stronger.
- Administrative work is grouped into a single lighter block.
- Only one task cannot fully fit before   17:30  :   15 minutes of slide prep  .
